title: 18033 - 18033/P1625/005669
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to Transmission Kontrol Modülü (J217) faulty
stepByStepSolution:
Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to Transmission Kontrol Modülü (J217)
Kontrol edin:  Measuring Value Block (MVB) 125+
technicalNotes: This Fault Code is stored in case of Communication Problems with the Transmission Kontrol Modülü (J217).
model: Cayenne, Macan, Panamera, 911, Taycan, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, Q3, Q5, Q7, Q8, Leon, Ibiza, Ateca, Arona, Tarraco, Octavia, Superb, Kodiaq, Karoq, Fabia, Scala, Passat, Golf, Jetta, Tiguan, Polo, Arteon, Touareg, Transporter, Caddy, Amarok, Scirocco
